items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the assessment
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 22 Dec 2025. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter posted by mail counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Fri 26 Dec 2025. That day is Zweiter Weihnachtstag, a public holiday in NW, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deemed-delivery day shifts to the next working day, Mon 29 Dec 2025. Counting the one-month Einspruch period starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later, on Thu 29 Jan 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB), which is itself a normal working day so no further shift applies.
